_comment: Gripper link settings. Angles are servo degrees. Forces are raw FSR ADC counts (0-4095, 3.3k divider) until calibrated.
_calibrate: Measured Nov 22 (after re-seating the horn): 15 deg = fully open (63 mm, quiet), 60 deg = 40 mm, closed end 26.5 mm at ~86.5 deg (servo buzzes there): 0.51 mm of opening per servo degree, bigger angle = closed. angle_min/angle_max are the hard clamp on every pulse sent, just inside the ends; open_angle/closed_angle a few degrees inside those. attach_angle (where the servo jumps when gripper_link starts) is mid-travel. Re-check with `grip_cmd.py angle N` if the horn is ever moved.
_servo: MZ996 on Pi hardware PWM: GPIO19 (pin 35) = PWM0_1, 50 Hz, pulse_min_us..pulse_max_us = 0..180 deg. Powered from the Pi's 5 V pin.
_contact: contact_force: if the jaws close all the way to closed_angle and the stronger FSR peaked at >= this, count it as GRIPPED. 0 = always (Nov 22: the squeeze bottle is held firmly at 84 deg while both FSRs read idle ~8; vision already checked the object is there).
